comment: Group tree of the interface. Ids with a dot are nested in their parent (parent is required).
order sets the position among siblings. Rules refer to a group with the field group.

groups.title: Installation
groups.summary: What the answer file does by its own means and by its scripts: the passes of the installation, OOBE, the scripts of the installation, the first sign-in and the task after OOBE; the data forms are here too

groups.title: Policies
groups.summary: Every rule that only writes the registry, policies or other values, and every imported policy template

groups.title: Other
groups.summary: Rules that are not only registry values or answer file settings: services, features, capabilities, apps, programs, scripts on a running Windows and their mixes with registry values

groups.title: windowsPE and specialize
groups.summary: Bypassing compatibility checks, Setup without diagnostic data and Dynamic Update, a local account without a network connection.

groups.title: Out-of-box experience (OOBE)
groups.summary: Which OOBE screens are hidden and how the privacy settings are set.

groups.title: Windows Update
groups.summary: Automatic updates, other Microsoft products, feature update deferral, Delivery Optimization.

groups.title: Microsoft Defender and SmartScreen
groups.summary: Real-time protection, cloud-delivered protection, PUA, network protection, ASR rules, SmartScreen.

groups.title: Attack surface reduction (ASR) rules
groups.summary: Each rule blocks one attack technique through Office, email, scripts, USB or drivers. Mode: block, audit, warn.

groups.title: Security
groups.summary: UAC, accounts, credential protection, remote access, encryption.

groups.title: Network and sharing
groups.summary: SMB signing, name resolution, firewall.

groups.title: Browsers
groups.summary: Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome and Brave policies: security, telemetry, advertising, AI features. Part of the policies is on by default: telemetry, advertising, AI features, page translation, card autofill, the Brave wallet and VPN; sync, browser sign-in and password managers are off. Policies for a browser that is not installed have no effect.

groups.title: Logging for investigations
groups.summary: Auditing, log sizes, disabling PowerShell 2.0.

groups.title: Telemetry, ads, AI
groups.summary: Minimal data sending, disabling ads and preinstalled apps, Copilot and Recall, widgets, web search.

groups.title: System
groups.summary: Other system settings.

groups.title: Services and apps
groups.summary: Disabling unnecessary services, the Print Spooler started automatically, removing apps.

groups.title: Apps to remove
groups.summary: Each app is a separate rule: clear the check box to keep the app.

groups.title: Default user profile
groups.summary: Values that every new user gets at first sign-in (can be changed in Settings).

groups.title: After OOBE (scheduled task)
groups.summary: Scheduled task after OOBE completes: passwords, built-in accounts, cleanup.

groups.title: Artificial intelligence
groups.summary: Copilot, Recall, Click to Do, AI agents, Windows generative features, Paint and Notepad.

groups.title: Telemetry and feedback
groups.summary: Windows diagnostic data, reports, feedback requests, Steps Recorder.

groups.title: Microsoft Office
groups.summary: Copilot and connected experiences in Office, diagnostic data and feedback; the settings are written to the default user profile.

groups.title: OneDrive
groups.summary: OneDrive client policies: moving folders to the cloud, network traffic, feedback, a complete block; its installer removed from the default user profile.

groups.title: File Explorer and the desktop
groups.summary: Folders in "This PC", items of the navigation pane and icons on the desktop. Off by default, so Windows keeps its own choice, except that "Gallery" is hidden.

groups.title: Folders in "This PC"
groups.summary: User folders (hidden in Windows 11), "3D Objects", "Recycle Bin" and "Control Panel" above the drives. Off by default: "This PC" shows the drives only, as in Windows 11.

groups.title: Navigation pane
groups.summary: "Home", "Gallery", "Libraries", "Network", "Recycle Bin" and the user folder in the left pane of File Explorer, and the folder File Explorer opens to.

groups.title: Desktop icons
groups.summary: "This PC", the user folder, "Network", "Control Panel" and "Recycle Bin" (the icons of the Desktop icon settings dialog), "Libraries" and the Windows Spotlight icon on the desktop of new accounts.

groups.title: Folders on the desktop
groups.summary: "Documents", "Downloads", "Music", "Pictures", "Videos", "Desktop", "Gallery" and "Home" as icons on the desktop of new accounts. Rarely needed.

groups.title: Installation scripts (specialize)
groups.summary: .NET Framework 3.5 and drivers from the installation media.

groups.title: First sign-in
groups.summary: Scripts of the first sign-in of every new user: the display language pinned, the input languages of the profile.

groups.title: Security
groups.summary: Account lockout and password expiry, set with net accounts.

groups.title: Telemetry, ads, AI
groups.summary: Minimal telemetry with its services and tasks; Copilot, Recall and Click to Do off together with the Recall feature.

groups.title: Ads and recommendations
groups.summary: Advertising ID, tips and suggestions, preinstalled apps, the lock screen, ads in File Explorer and Settings.

groups.title: Speech and input
groups.summary: Cloud speech recognition, handwriting and typing personalization, Narrator online services.

groups.title: Apps
groups.summary: Policies and values of apps: OneDrive.

groups.title: Logging for investigations
groups.summary: PowerShell logging.

groups.title: Network and sharing
groups.summary: SMB 1.0 and NetBIOS over TCP/IP.

groups.title: System
groups.summary: Windows Update unblocked, VBScript removed, USB drives once in the navigation pane.
